effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Angoramon] in its text or the [NSp] trait attacks, by suspending this Tamer, activate 1 of the effects below:
· It may digivolve into a level 6 or lower card with [Angoramon] in its text or the [NSp] trait in the hand with the cost reduced by 1.
· You may use 1 Option card with [Angoramon] in its text or the [NSp] trait from your hand with the cost reduced by 2.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
